// Part of the Dim Factory web starter. MIT License: copy, change and share it freely.
// The pages and their addresses. To add a page: make it in src/pages/, add it to PAGES below, and add a link to
// site.nav in content.ts when it belongs in the menu.
import { useEffect } from 'react'
import type { ComponentType } from 'react'
import { Layout } from './components/Layout'
import { about, site } from './content'
import { RouterProvider, useRoute } from './lib/router'
import { About } from './pages/About'
import { Home } from './pages/Home'
import { NotFound } from './pages/NotFound'

const PAGES: Record<string, { title: string | null; page: ComponentType }> = {
  '/': { title: null, page: Home },
  '/about': { title: about.title, page: About },
}

function Page() {
  const { path } = useRoute()
  const found = PAGES[path.length > 1 ? path.replace(/\/+$/, '') : path]
  const title = found === undefined ? 'Page not found' : found.title
  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = title === null ? site.name : `${title} · ${site.name}`
  }, [title])
  const Current = found?.page ?? NotFound
  return <Current />
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <RouterProvider>
      <Layout>
        <Page />
      </Layout>
    </RouterProvider>
  )
}
